Any stale or incorrect reference weakens the decision's consolidation claim.

The override-recording text names specific event and field identifiers (decision_recorded, alert_dismissed_or_ignored, authority_source = user_override, preference_inference_allowed = false) as already existing in section 17.0 while also asserting the policy adds no kernel field or Log event type. If any identifier does not already exist, that assertion is false and the patch silently introduces schema.

The mode table presents snake_case identifiers (off, text_only, voice_session, discovery_mode, meeting_logging, local_only_realtime, cloud_assisted_realtime) as 'the existing mode vocabulary'. If these names are new rather than inherited from UBU-D0272's RealtimeSession, the decision introduces identifiers without saying so.

The DESIGN section is very dense; many distinct normative constraints are packed into long paragraphs, which reduces auditability and raises the chance of subtle conflicts with the prior consent, silence, pause and restricted-attention contracts it claims to consolidate.
Decision type is Product with human approval required, so this cross-score cannot substitute for the required human sign-off on the policy content.
